title: ARP Spoofing / MITM Attack
story: An attacker performs ARP poisoning to intercept traffic. Students must identify and mitigate the attack.

tasks.title: Detect Duplicate ARP Entries
tasks.description: Find conflicting ARP mappings that indicate poisoning.
tasks.hint: Inspect arp -a or ip neigh output.

tasks.title: Analyze Traffic
tasks.description: Review captured traffic for signs of interception.
tasks.hint: Look for gratuitous ARP or repeated ARP replies.

tasks.title: Enable Static ARP
tasks.description: Pin the trusted gateway MAC address to reduce spoofing risk.
tasks.hint: Use ip neigh replace or arp -s.

tasks.title: Block Attacker
tasks.description: Prevent the attacker's traffic from reaching the host.
tasks.hint: Use firewall or switch controls to block the attacker.
